title: The 30-page edition is complete in draft
headline: The writer finished the 30-page edition at 23:19: five chapters and the series page, about 9,800 words, attached as a 27-page draft PDF with cover A. Several pictures are now in: the cast cards, ruv-sgit's strips, the reviewer card and a timeline of the afternoon. Some still print as boxes to come. Chapters 1 to 3 are cleared by security and traced by the researcher; chapters 4 and 5 are read by the test readers and go to security and the researcher next. The 3- and 10-page editions are rebuilt with 'Ship' and the corrected line about the hold, and security has cleared them. Their PDFs go on the editions page with this release. I recorded Leanpub as the full book (LP1). Nothing needs you tonight.
